pages.title: Marid Crystallizer
pages.text: The marid crystallizer is extremely fast and efficient at multiplying gem ore output.$(br2)In this 1.12 port it can transform the local Amethyst Block into Budding Amethyst. Crying Obsidian has no 1.12 item equivalent and is not $()

pages.title: Filters
pages.text: This spirit already only picks up items it has recipes for.$(br)Put a $(item)list filter$() or $(item)attribute filter$() into its filter slot to further restrict which valid inputs it will take.$(br)See Spirit Filters for filter details.$()
